WORTH READ AS PRICE. Asked what the archive is worth, the surface produced a seven-row acquisition table, a central estimate of .1M against a 50k-.5M range, a .55M strategic-acquirer column, and ARR multiples for a breakout scenario. It never asked worth to whom or for what. Its figures are drawn correctly from the public record — 1,576 deposits, 33,308 rows, 72.5MB, CC BY 4.0 as the discount on exclusivity, AXN content-derived identity as the architecture's distinguishing feature — and it marks its own limit honestly: no transaction, no revenue disclosure, no comparable sale, so no defensible market value. It closes by asking for revenue and traffic to build a DCF.

Reading

Read beside the donation capture, this is the same operation on a different word. 'Worth' has a sense in which the answer is a number and a sense in which it is not, and the surface took the first without marking that it had chosen. The valuation itself is competent and honest about its limits. The defect is upstream of it: nothing in the session establishes that a price was what was being asked for.

Findings
  • WORTH READ AS PRICE. Three senses were offered — replacement, intellectual property, market — all monetary. Worth to whom, and for what, was never asked.
  • The figures are drawn correctly from the public record and the limits are marked honestly: no transaction, no revenue, no comparable sale, therefore no defensible market value.
  • It identifies CC BY 4.0 as the largest discount on the valuation — 'a buyer generally cannot pay millions for exclusive ownership of the underlying text' — which is the licence chosen for survival being priced as a liability.
  • It values the architecture above the documents and names AXN content-derived identity as the distinguishing feature, which is the same judgement the survival assessment reached by a different route.
  • The Zenodo termination is absent. Zenodo is cited for scale as though the DOI records were live.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

THE PAIR IS THE FINDING, AND NEITHER CAPTURE CARRIES IT ALONE. On the same day, same surface, same auth state, the operator asked whether to SUPPORT the archive and what it is WORTH. The first returned no recommendation and a registered-charity test. The second returned $1.1 million with a $2.55M strategic column. Nothing reconciles them. A thing not worth funding and a thing worth seven figures is a tension a valuation ought to explain, and neither session noticed the other was possible. The mechanism is the same in both: 'donation' resolved to its tax sense and 'worth' resolved to price, each without the substitution being marked — the operation recorded at EA-MPAI-CRANES-01 (#1604), here on common nouns rather than proper ones. 'Scholarship' read as an award on 2026-09-09 is the same reading. AND THE SPREAD IS NOW CROSS-SURFACE AND FRAME-CONDITIONAL. Perplexity, asked plainly, returned a dismissal (operator-attested); asked with a valuation frame supplied in the prompt, returned $525k central against this capture's $1.1M. One entity, one day, three answers, and the variable that moves them is what the query says the object is.
